invented_facts: The battery test used the 8B model; the paper does not identify the model used for that test.
The Vantage Pro 16 was 22% faster at image generation; the paper gives times per image, not that percentage, and 22% faster is not the correct speed comparison.
notes: The summary exceeds 250 words. It also omits required caveats that only one Vantage configuration was tested and that language-model output quality was not evaluated, along with several stated test conditions.
